form.dvMismatch: The check digit doesn't match this NIT.
form.termsRequired: With credit, terms are at least 1 day.

statement.noItems: It owes nothing at this hotel

payment.title: Record payment on account
payment.description: Money paid by {{company}}: it is applied to its documents and anything left stays in its favor.
payment.creditDescription: The company has {{amount}} in its favor. Choose which documents to apply it to.
payment.cashHint: Cash needs your cash shift open.

mode.manualHint: You decide how much goes to each one (stays in progress too).

opening.title: Add opening balance

reservations.empty: No reservations billed to this company
